title: Kidney disease in pregnancy

steps.tx: Normal **gestational renal physiology** produces a **40%** to **50%** expansion in renal plasma flow and glomerular filtration rate mediated by corpus luteum-derived **relaxin** stimulating endothelial nitric oxide synthesis. Consequently, normal healthy pregnancy features lower baseline **serum creatinine** values spanning **0.4** to **0.6** mg/dL, such that values > 0.8 mg/dL indicate genuine renal impairment.
steps.say: Normal gestational renal physiology produces a 40 percent to 50 percent expansion in renal plasma flow and glomerular filtration rate mediated by corpus luteum-derived relaxin stimulating endothelial nitric oxide synthesis. steps.tx: Clinical consensus criteria define **Preeclampsia** as new-onset systolic blood pressure >= **140/90** mmHg occurring after **20** weeks of gestation, accompanied by new **proteinuria** exceeding **300** mg per **24** hours (or spot protein-creatinine ratio >= **0.3** mg/mg) or evidence of maternal acute kidney injury, thrombocytopenia, or cerebral visual disturbances.
steps.say: Clinical consensus criteria define Preeclampsia as new-onset systolic blood pressure 140/90 mmHg or higher occurring after 20 weeks of gestation, accompanied by new proteinuria exceeding 300 mg per 24 hours or spot protein-creatinine ratio 0.3 mg/mg or higher, or evidence of maternal acute kidney injury, thrombocytopenia, or cerebral visual disturbances.

right.title: Gestational Hypertension
points: Normal platelet count and liver enzymes

steps.tx: Defective endovascular trophoblastic invasion of uterine spiral arteries provokes chronic placental ischemia and hypoxia, triggering massive syncytiotrophoblast secretion of antiangiogenic factors. Circulating **soluble fms-like tyrosine kinase-1** (**sFlt-1**) and **soluble endoglin** neutralize maternal VEGF and TGF-beta, causing widespread maternal endothelial dysfunction and capillary leak.

steps.tx: The circulating serum **sFlt-1/PlGF ratio** functions as a highly accurate biomarker for ruling out suspected preeclampsia. In women presenting between 24 and 37 weeks gestation with clinical suspicion, a validated cutoff ratio <= **38** exhibits a **99%** negative predictive value, reliably ruling out preeclampsia development for **1** to **4** weeks.
steps.say: The circulating serum sFlt-1 to PlGF ratio functions as a highly accurate biomarker for ruling out suspected preeclampsia. In women presenting between 24 and 37 weeks gestation with clinical suspicion, a validated cutoff ratio of 38 or less exhibits a 99% negative predictive value, reliably ruling out preeclampsia development for 1 to 4 weeks.

rows: Close ambulatory monitoring within 1 to 2 weeks

steps.tx: Renal histopathology in severe preeclampsia demonstrates pathognomonic **glomerular endotheliosis**. Light and electron microscopy reveal markedly swollen, vacuolated glomerular **endothelial cells** that obliterate capillary lumens, accompanied by loss of endothelial fenestrations, subendothelial fibrinoid deposits, and complete absence of immune complex deposits.

Light and electron microscopy reveal markedly swollen, vacuolated glomerular endothelial cells that obliterate capillary lumens, accompanied by loss of endothelial fenestrations, subendothelial fibrinoid deposits, and complete absence of immune complex deposits.

steps.tx: Safe first-line pharmacotherapies for chronic hypertension or preeclampsia during pregnancy encompass oral **labetalol**, extended-release **nifedipine**, and oral **methyldopa**. Conversely, **ACE inhibitors**, angiotensin receptor blockers (**ARBs**), direct renin inhibitors, and mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists are strictly **contraindicated** due to lethal fetal oligohydramnios, renal tubular dysgenesis, and skull hypoplasia.

steps.tx: Severe complications including **HELLP syndrome** (hemolysis, elevated liver enzymes, low platelets) occur in **10%** to **20%** of severe preeclampsia cases. Emergency management mandates seizure prophylaxis using intravenous **magnesium sulfate**, tight hemodynamic stabilization, and urgent planned **delivery** of the fetus regardless of gestational age once stabilized.

steps.tx: Maintenance hemodialysis in pregnant end-stage kidney disease patients requires intensive **nocturnal or daily dialysis** protocols delivering >= **36** to **48** hours per week. Rigorous clearance targeting a predialysis blood urea nitrogen (**BUN**) < **35** to **45** mg/dL prevents polyhydramnios and maternal uremia, dramatically elevating **live birth** rates above **85%** to **90%**.
steps.say: Maintenance hemodialysis in pregnant end-stage kidney disease patients requires intensive nocturnal or daily dialysis protocols delivering 36 to 48 hours per week or more. Rigorous clearance targeting a predialysis blood urea nitrogen below 35 to 45 mg/dL prevents polyhydramnios and maternal uremia, dramatically elevating live birth rates above 85% to 90%.
